---
title: "Interval To Event Transform"
---

## Overview

The `IntervalToEvent` transform extracts one event per interval from a `DigitalIntervalSeries`, producing a `DigitalEventSeries` with a 1:1 row mapping. This is the materialized counterpart to the alignment-point extraction in `IntervalWithAlignmentAdapter` used by `GatherResult`, and is the inverse of `EventToInterval` for point intervals.

Each interval produces one event at the selected alignment point:

```text
Start  -> interval.start
End    -> interval.end
Center -> (interval.start + interval.end) / 2
```

Extraction is performed in **TimeFrameIndex space** (not absolute clock time). The output preserves the input `TimeFrame`.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/TransformsV2/algorithms/IntervalToEvent/IntervalToEvent.hpp` | Parameter struct, enum, and function declaration |
| `src/TransformsV2/algorithms/IntervalToEvent/IntervalToEvent.cpp` | Algorithm implementation and JSON enum converter |
| `src/TransformsV2/algorithms/IntervalToEvent/IntervalToEvent.test.cpp` | Unit tests |

## Parameters

```cpp
enum class IntervalEventPoint { start, end, center };

struct IntervalToEventParams {
    IntervalEventPoint point{IntervalEventPoint::start};
};
```

The `point` field serializes as `"start"`, `"end"`, or `"center"` in JSON pipeline loading.

## Algorithm

1. For each interval, compute the event time from `params.point`.
2. Collect all event times into a vector (preserving input order).
3. Return `DigitalEventSeries` with `setTimeFrame(input.getTimeFrame())`.

Source entity IDs are not copied to the output events.

## Registration

Registered in `RegisteredTransforms.cpp` as:

```cpp
RegisterContainerTransform<DigitalIntervalSeries, DigitalEventSeries, IntervalToEventParams>(
    "IntervalToEvent", intervalToEvent, ...);
```

## Pipeline Usage

```json
{
  "steps": [{
    "step_id": "extract_alignment",
    "transform_name": "IntervalToEvent",
    "input_key": "trial_intervals",
    "output_key": "alignment_events",
    "parameters": {
      "point": "center"
    }
  }]
}
```

## Relationship to GatherResult Migration

This transform implements the interval-to-alignment-point portion described in `digital_interval_series_migration_design.qmd`. For display windows around interval-derived points, compose with `EventToInterval`:

```text
DigitalIntervalSeries -> IntervalToEvent -> DigitalEventSeries -> EventToInterval -> DigitalIntervalSeries
```

## Edge Cases

| Input | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| Empty interval series | Returns empty `DigitalEventSeries` with preserved TimeFrame |
| Point interval `[T, T]` | Start, end, and center all map to `T` |
| Overlapping intervals | One event per interval row (not merged) |
| Cancellation | Returns empty event series with preserved TimeFrame |

## Tests

Colocated tests cover empty input, start/end/center extraction, order preservation, odd-length center (integer division), TimeFrame propagation, registry execution, JSON parameter loading, and round-trip with `EventToInterval` at zero expansion.
